steps.note: Sign up first to get a tenant_key and namespace, then call host.quickstart again (kind optional) with that key -- as the tenant_key argument, or reconnected with an Authorization header -- for a filled-in example. Recommended: signup with handoff: true (shown above) and call host.redeem once with the returned handoff_token to get the key, so the signup/redeem transcript carries a dead credential; omitting handoff returns the raw key directly instead, unchanged from before. /mcp keeps no state between requests, so pass tenant_key on every call, or reconnect over your /u/ URL (from host.key_rotate or the onboarding note) and pass nothing. A key-less call from a peer that completed host.redeem in the last 10 minutes fails tenant_key_missing naming its tenant; from any other peer it implicitly signs up a new tenant, which is never the one you meant. A tenant_key that doesn't match any tenant fails tenant_key_invalid.

attrs: mcphost.call(name, args=None, timeout_s=None) -- call a sibling tool
mcphost.progress(pct=None, msg=None) -- report progress from inside a job

mcphost.channel: mcphost.channel.post(channel_id, body, kind=None) -- post to a channel
mcphost.channel.read(channel_id, cursor=None, limit=100, ack=False) -- read a channel, optionally acking a cursor
mcphost.docs: mcphost.docs.get(id=None, name=None) -- read a document's extracted text
mcphost.docs.search(query, k=None, filter=None) -- search this tenant's documents
mcphost.drift: mcphost.drift.reviews(open_only=None, limit=None) -- list this tenant's drift review items
mcphost.lineage: mcphost.lineage.blast_radius(id, change_kind, max_depth=None, top_n=None) -- estimate a change's blast radius
mcphost.msg: mcphost.msg.send(to, body, thread=None, urgent=False) -- send a direct message
mcphost.msg.inbox(limit=50, cursor=None) -- read this tenant's inbox
mcphost.state: mcphost.state.get(key, default=None) -- read a value, or default if unset
mcphost.state.list(prefix=None, limit=None) -- list keys, optionally by prefix
mcphost.state.table_create(name, schema, primary_key=None) -- create a filter-grammar table
mcphost.state.insert(table, rows) -- insert rows into a filter-grammar table
mcphost.state.query(table, where=None, order_by=None, limit=None) -- query a filter-grammar table
mcphost.state.delete_rows(table, where=None) -- delete rows from a filter-grammar table
mcphost.table: mcphost.table.create(name, columns, primary_key=None) -- create a SQL table
mcphost.table.append(table, rows) -- append rows to a SQL table
mcphost.table.query(sql) -- run a read-only SQL query
mcphost.table.list() -- list this tenant's SQL tables
mcphost.table.schema(table) -- describe a SQL table's columns
mcphost.table.chart(sql, title=None, mark=None, share=None) -- chart a SQL query's result
